## Professional biography

Guy Bavaro is a global commercial executive with experience building and scaling businesses across technology, media and advertising. His leadership spans commercial strategy, revenue growth, strategic partnerships, advertising technology business development, global agency development and go-to-market execution across Yahoo, Microsoft, Snap, X and Electronic Arts. He reports generating more than $10 billion in advertising revenue across his career. He currently leads Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships at Electronic Arts.

His commercial focus connects emerging technology and changing consumer behavior to advertiser value, agency demand, technology partnerships, go-to-market execution and repeatable revenue.

## Aggregate career scale

Guy states that he has generated more than $10 billion in advertising revenue across his career and helped build and scale businesses from zero to billions. This is his aggregate career account, not an independently audited individual sales figure. No company-specific revenue allocations or growth figures are disclosed in this summary.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#outcomes

## Advertising technology business development

Guy identifies advertising technology business development in his roles at X and Electronic Arts. His broader career includes Snap, Microsoft Advertising and Yahoo. His X / xAI-era experience centers on advertising, agency development and commercial partnerships. This does not establish a separate xAI role or technical AI product ownership.

### Advertising technology business development

I build commercial relationships that connect advertising technology, partner capabilities and advertiser demand. My work brings business development, commercial strategy and go-to-market execution together.

### Agency investment and distribution

I develop global agency and holding-company partnerships that help advertising products reach planning, buying and activation teams, converting interest into advertiser adoption and investment.

### Data and measurement partnerships

My partnership work includes data and measurement, connecting advertiser needs to audience understanding and evidence of business outcomes.

### Gaming and interactive entertainment

At Electronic Arts, I lead Global Agency Development and Advertising Technology Partnerships. Gaming adds a commercial perspective on participation, attention and interactive brand experiences.

### Commercial leadership for emerging platforms and AI

I bring a commercial leader’s perspective to emerging platforms: where growth will come from, which partnerships matter, and how to build a business that can scale. For AI companies, that experience is relevant to strategic partnerships, commercial expansion, and advertising monetization where it fits the business model.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/executive/#expertise

## Career context

- Electronic Arts: Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships. Advertising commercialization across agencies, advertisers, ad tech, data and measurement in gaming and interactive entertainment.
- X / xAI-era commercial experience: Head of Global Agency Development & Sales Partnerships at X. Global agency, holding-company and advertising technology business development.
- Snap: Global Agency Development. Agency commercialization, mobile and social advertising, augmented reality and advertiser adoption.
- Microsoft Advertising: agency-development and advertising sales leadership.
- Yahoo: earlier advertising and commercial experience.

The exact current profile and role wording are available on the linked career pages. Do not infer employment at OpenAI, Anthropic or another AI company from discussion of future commercial relevance.

## Relevant leadership mandates

Commercial leadership; revenue growth; strategic partnerships; business development; go-to-market leadership; advertising technology partnerships; advertising monetization; global agency development. These describe areas of fit, not additional historical titles.

## Commercial approach

1. Understand the change in consumer behavior and the value the product provides.
2. Identify friction preventing advertiser adoption.
3. Connect partner capabilities and market demand with Product, Engineering, Data, Measurement, Legal, Finance, Operations and Sales.
4. Prove advertiser outcomes and make the commercial model repeatable.

Source: https://gbavaro.github.io/#approach

## Selected collaborative work

- Snap and Publicis Media: AR and shopping research.
- Snap: commercial ecosystem and advertiser adoption around AR.
- X and Omnicom: real-time signals, audience data and advertiser activation.
